Export.title: Export
Export.ringHint: Every part fills whole sheets, so for a ring binder you can print one month at a time and leave out the introduction and crisis pages once you have them.

home-duplex.name: Two-sided, automatic
home-duplex.hint: For a printer that prints both sides by itself (duplex).

home-manual-duplex.name: Two-sided, by hand
home-manual-duplex.hint: For a printer without duplex: print the fronts, put the stack back in, print the backs. Two files.

home-a5-2up.name: A5 on A4 paper (two per sheet)
home-a5-2up.hint: Two A5 pages on each A4 sheet, both sides. Cut the whole stack in half once and put the right pile under the left: the pages are in order.

home-a5-native.name: A5 paper
home-a5-native.hint: For a printer with an A5 tray, both sides.

home-booklet.name: A5 booklet on A4 paper
home-booklet.hint: Folded bundles (signatures) of A4 sheets, two A5 pages on each side, to sew or staple. Pages come out in order when folded.

Export.reverseBacks: Backs in reverse order (most printers; check with the calibration sheet)

Export.actualSize: In the print dialog choose “Actual size” / 100% and no scaling, or the margins and holes will not line up.

instructions.home-duplex: Print on both sides, flipping on the long edge.
instructions.home-manual-duplex: Print file 1 (fronts). Put the printed stack back in the tray as the calibration sheet shows, then print file 2 (backs).
instructions.home-a5-2up: Print on both sides, flipping on the short edge. Cut each stack of sheets down the middle (the marks at the top and bottom), then put the right-hand pile under the left-hand pile.
instructions.home-a5-native: Print on both sides, flipping on the long edge.
instructions.home-booklet: Print on both sides, flipping on the short edge. Take the sheets of each bundle together (the file lists them in order), fold them in half along the marks, and stack the bundles in order.

Export.calibrationHint: Print the calibration sheet first: both rulers must be exactly 100 mm, and the crosses on the two sides should meet when you hold the sheet against the light.

calibration.title: Printer calibration
calibration.rulers: Each ruler must measure exactly 100 mm. If not, turn off “Fit to page” and print at 100%.
calibration.front: Print this sheet on both sides. Hold it against the light: the crosses on the front and back should meet. A few millimetres off is normal; the binding margin allows for it.
calibration.back: Back side. The crosses should meet the ones on the front. If this side is upside down, choose the other flip edge in the print dialog.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.summary: YAPCO has no accounts, no cookies and no analytics. Your planners stay in your browser; they only leave it for a moment when you create a PDF.

stored.title: What is stored, and where
stored.body: Planners, their texts and quotes, and anything you type into them (such as your name or dates) are stored only in this browser, in its local database (IndexedDB). They are not sent to us and there is no copy on a server. The interface language you choose is remembered in the browser's local storage. So that the site also works without a connection, the browser keeps a copy of the site's own files (its pages and code, none of your planners) in its cache.

tracking.title: No tracking
tracking.body: The site sets no cookies and uses no analytics, advertising or tracking services.

export.title: Creating a PDF
export.body: When you press “Create PDF”, the planner (its layout, texts and any names or dates you filled in) is sent over an encrypted connection to the site's PDF service. The service opens it in a temporary browser on Cloudflare (Browser Run), prints the pages and sends the PDF back. The planner is not stored or logged. On your own computer, the local export service does the same without anything leaving the computer.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: The site runs on Cloudflare. Like any website, Cloudflare processes technical data such as IP addresses to deliver and protect the site, under its own privacy policy. A rate limit on PDF creation uses your IP address for one minute and keeps nothing afterwards.

paper.title: Your notes belong on paper
paper.body: The planner is meant to be printed blank and filled in by hand. Please do not type health or therapy notes into the designer: printed pages are the safest place for them.

backups.title: Backups and deleting
backups.body: Clearing this site's data in your browser deletes your planners for good. Use “Save planner as JSON” on the Export screen to keep a copy. Deleting a planner on the dashboard removes it from this browser.

Guide.title: How to fill in the planner
Guide.printHint: Print or save as PDF: A4, actual size, no headers.
Guide.intro: This guide walks through every kind of page in the planner: what to write in each part, and why it helps. The pictures show pages filled in by an example person, Marek; all names, numbers and events are made up.
Guide.legend: <hand>Grey handwriting</hand> is an example of what you might write. <note>→ Lighter notes with an arrow</note> explain what a part is for. Neither is printed in your own planner.
